sentences.japanese: こちらは私の友達のレイチェルです。私たちは同じ高校に通っていました。
sentences.english: This is my friend Rachel. We went to high school together.

sentences.japanese: 都会では気付かれず通り過ぎることもあるだろうが、村の中ではそうはいかない。
sentences.english: In a town you may pass unnoticed, whereas in a village it's impossible.

sentences.japanese: 私の言った通りにしなさい。
sentences.english: You are to do as I tell you.

sentences.japanese: 君は私がすすめる通りにするほうがよい。
sentences.english: You had better do as I suggest.

sentences.japanese: 君は言われた通りにしなければならない。
sentences.english: You must do as you are told to do.
